task_description:
Perform a contact and category cleanup with emergency tagging:

1) For the duplicate “Alice Chan” entries, retain the more complete record (the one with multiple phone numbers, addresses, and an email). Consolidate any unique phone number from the other “Alice Chan” into the retained record and ensure it also has the Sports category. Then delete the redundant “Alice Chan” entry.

2) Fix the category naming inconsistency by renaming category CAT-SPORTS so that its category_name is “Sports” (keep its description about sports partners/gym buddies).

3) Create a new category “Emergency” with id CAT-EMER and description “Contacts to reach immediately in urgent situations.” Assign this “Emergency” category to the “Green Valley Hospital” contact.
